name: Readercon
blurb: A literary speculative-fiction conference near Boston with a near-total focus on the written word; hosts the Shirley Jackson Awards.

editions.evidence: Homepage text: "Readercon 36 July 8 – 11, 2027 Boston Marriott Burlington in Burlington, MA" and "Guests of Honor: Neil Clarke and Fonda Lee"

notes: Memorial Guest of Honor not yet named ("To be announced" on site), so excluded. The guests page is Cloudflare-protected (needed --channel msedge to render) and shows no guest photos, only the site logo, so the two confirmed Guests of Honor are recorded as textOnlyGuests. The homepage's only image is a small transparent logo, used as the cover.
